description: Fetch Evidence Scores for 2-20 retailer listings and rank them by GoBuy Evidence Score (highest first). Use this when an agent is choosing between multiple products. For a single product lookup, use `check_product_trust` instead. Read-only — does not modify any state or place orders, and never fetches reviews. Unindexed products rank last. This is not purchase advice.

products.description: Array of 2-20 product references to compare and rank.

product_id.description: Native retailer product ID, such as an Amazon ASIN (e.g. 'B0BXYCS74H').

retailer.description: Marketplace containing the listing: amazon, walmart, target, or bestbuy.

name: compare_products
title: Compare and Rank Products
